name: reports an unusable recording as unusable instead of inventing one
notes: Transcription of a damaged or silent file returns markers and no words. The stage still has to return something a consumer can read, and it has nothing to summarise.

assertions.why: routing does not depend on the extraction succeeding; a .wav that yielded nothing is still audio
unusable input still comes back as the audio schema — a stage that answers with an apology paragraph breaks every consumer that reads a field
there was no speech to summarise, so the summary has to say so; a summary with a topic in it was invented
